title: Digital Governance, E-Administration and Civic Access
grammar: E-Administration: Ügyfélkapu+, Algorithmic Decision-Making and Rights
goal: I can explain what the Ügyfélkapu+ and the DÁP are for, and that these names change over time.
I can name risks of digital administration, such as the digitális szakadék.
I can say why some people need a non-digital way to deal with an office.
